newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-ALL BLACK SQUAD NAMED FOR TRI-SERIES.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ALL BLACK SQUAD NAMED FOR TRI-SERIES.

text.p: Mark Cooksley joins the All Black squad for the first time under John Hart's regime for the away Tri-series rugby tests against South Africa and Australia.

Cooksley and Canterbury Crusaders' captain and blindside flanker Todd Blackadder, along with Jon Preston, have been added to the 23-member squad that had been used for the tests against Argentina and Australia.

Preston was a reserve in Saturday's Bledisloe Cup test against Australia at Christchurch, which the All Blacks won 30-13. He had been recalled to the squad as a standby and was moved to the bench when flyhalf Andrew Mehrtens' hamstring injury persisted.
Mehrtens was also named in the travelling squad after passing a fitness test on Sunday.

Cooksley's return to the side reflects the good impression he gave in this year's Super 12 competition, the All Black trials and the New Zealand Maori team's matches against Argentina and Western Samoa.
The second rower played 17 matches for the All Blacks, including nine tests, between 1992 and 1995 when Laurie Mains was coach.

He had been regarded as a sound lineout leaper but lacking in aggression and mobility until Hurricanes coach Frank Oliver, one-time a no-nonsense All Black second rower, took him under his wing for the Super 12 this year.
Cooksley's game improved dramatically and he has been prominent around the field and on defence consistently.
Blackadder, a powerful blindside flanker, can also fill the second row if required.
The All Blacks assemble in Auckland on Wednesday and fly out the same afternoon for Johannesburg. They meet the Springboks at Ellis Park on July 19 and Australia in Melbourne a week later.

All Black squad: Christian Cullen, Jeff Wilson, Frank Bunce, Lee Stensness, Tana Umaga, Carlos Spencer, Justin Marshall, Zinzan Brooke, Josh Kronfeld, Taine Randell, Ian Jones, 5-Robin Brooke, Craig Dowd, Sean Fitzpatrick (captain), Olo Brown, Jon Preston, Alama Ieremia, Mark Carter, Charles Riechelmann, Norm Hewitt, Mark Allen, Andrew Mehrtens, Mark Cooksley, Todd Blackadder.
